spans.text: ...On the other end of the battlefield.
In an alleyway.
Dammit... Screw everything! That Nyto deliberately showed her face to us before running off!
When I find her, I'm gonna tear her in two with my teeth...no, I'll just do it with my hands!
But first, we must locate the Chairwoman...
I handed her a signal emitter a while ago just to be safe. That Nyto hasn't gone very far. Rather... Why have they stopped all of a sudden...?
Is she giving up? Has she finally figured out that there's no escape from me?!
Don't be silly... There must be a reason. We'd better be careful. I've sent out the coordinates to everyone else in the team. We'll surround them to make sure they don't slip away.
RO635 promptly marks out several points on the map. SOP-II and the others start moving immediately.
...Ten minutes later.
Outside an abandoned old building.
We've already got this battered building surrounded. No one has reported any sign of Nyto or the Chairwoman.
This is the only place...that Nyto could appear.
But no one seems to be stationed here...?
SOP-II points out what is puzzling me. Not a single enemy signal has been detected throughout the entire structure, but for whatever reason, that's also what makes me so apprehensive.
In any case, let's go in first...
Stay alert!
As we enter the spacious room, we find nothing out of the ordinary... Just Chairwoman Ulrich bound to a wooden chair, watching us barge in with a cheerless smile.
I'm sorry...
...Five minutes ago.
Inside the room at the outpost.
Ulrich glares back at the black-clad woman staring down at her. That smile leaves her slightly unsettled.
Kill me...if you want! But the living won't give in! Do you think you can achieve anything through violence and terrorism?
Nimogen gazes down at Ulrich. Her smile suddenly disappears and her face becomes completely emotionless and serene.
But this new serenity makes the Chairwoman even more uneasy.
I have no interest in humans' capricious "ideals".
Capricious...
No matter how great you claim your "whateverism" is, in the end it's just another way of packaging your own greed. Big yawn.
Nimogen suddenly stops talking. She's still looking at Ulrich, but her eyes are unfocused.
Ulrich naturally doesn't know Nimogen is receiving new commands. All she can see is that after a brief period of dazed silence, that eerie smile returns to Nimogen's face again.
Oh dear, so that's how it is...
You've just become worthless. Heeheehee, that's right, that's what makes it all so interesting~
Now, I'd better go back and teach those pieces of trash a lesson—
Nimogen suddenly stops in her tracks again.

Oh, looks like my cute little sister has run into some trouble. No matter. You lot will soon have to deal with the calamity brought about by your so-called "ideals". Suffering slowly is the only ending you deserve, heeheeheehee...
With that, Nimogen turns to leave.
Wait!
The calamity caused by my ideals... What do you mean by that?
Nimogen glances back at the Chairwoman and gives her a meaningful grin.
You still haven't noticed?
...Back in the present.
She said that, then left.
Then not long afterwards, you appeared at the entrance of the room.
Calamity... Could she be referring to the ELIDs...?
I don't know... I didn't understand a thing she said...

I don't know who she is or why I've been taken. I also don't understand why she just left after she went to all that trouble to abduct me. But back then she looked like she's completed some kind of mission...
My instinct tells me they must've achieved something very important...
Something very important...you say?
In any case, your safety comes first. Let's hurry to the extraction point while we still have time!
RO gently helps Chairwoman Ulrich get up from the chair. The Chairwoman takes her hand in a strong grip.
I know it isn't my place to say this, but the world could be a better place because of you.
No matter what the enemy plans on doing, it can't be anything good. Please stop them if you can.
And be "a shining beacon in a brave new world"?
Chairwoman Ulrich pauses briefly, then smiles at RO.
Yes, a shining beacon in a brave new world.
Don't worry. Even if you hadn't asked, we won't let them get away with this.
Now, Madam, let's go! The Commander is still waiting for us!
